package migr

import (
	"time"

	"example.com/migr/clock"
)

// Queue's methods start with a World field; its helpers don't.
type Queue struct {
	w    *dst.World
	last clock.Mono
}

// touch reads the project's own clock: -map turns both calls into the
// World's.
func (q *Queue) touch() time.Duration {
	q.last = clock.Now()
	return q.last.Elapsed()
}

// shard has two type parameters: -world must still find its receiver.
type shard[K comparable, V any] struct {
	w  *dst.World
	ch chan V
}

func (s *shard[K, V]) init() {
	s.ch = make(chan V, 1)
}
